capabilities: Rename pasted images to their hash value (SHA-512 by default)
Skip renaming for pasted or copied files inside configured ignored directories
Optionally rename copied image, video, audio, and document files
Pick ignore directories via keyword fuzzy search with deduplication
Switch settings and notification language between English and Chinese
extras: README is bilingual (Chinese and English); installable from Community Plugins or GitHub Releases; MIT licensed.
intentEvidence: This project is modified and extended from hardingadonis/hash-pasted-image.
problem: Obsidian saves pasted images under generic default names, and there is no built-in way to rename them deterministically or skip renaming in chosen folders.

relations.evidence: This project is modified and extended from hardingadonis/hash-pasted-image.

summary: Renames images pasted into the vault using a hash algorithm (SHA-512 by default), with ignored directories, bilingual UI, and fuzzy folder selection.
